name.value: Vanguard MSCI Index International Shares (Hedged) ETF
name.note: Name on Vanguard's fact sheet dated 30 Sep 2026 and the PDS dated 1 Sep 2026 (unlike VGS, not renamed so far).

index.value: MSCI World ex-Australia Index (net dividends reinvested), hedged to AUD

mer.note: Management fee. The PDS (1 Sep 2026) adds 0.01% estimated indirect costs: 0.22% p.a. in total.

yield.note: Trailing 12 months of cash distributions (two half-yearly payouts) / NAV on 16 Oct 2026. Vanguard's 1-year income return was 3.34% to 30 Sep 2026 (fact sheet). Payouts swing a lot because currency-hedging gains and losses flow into them (nil in Jan 2023, Jul 2023 and Jan 2024).

franking.note: Franking credits are effectively nil (overseas shares)

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: Fund inception; listed on the ASX 20 Nov 2014

distributions.note: Half-yearly (periods ending 30 Jun and 31 Dec; ex-dates in early Jan and early Jul)
